title: Luxuriant Spicy Russian Fish Nimono
description: A spicy and indulgent Russian dish featuring fish in a glassy-jelly sauce, made with yellow food colouring and simmered to perfection, sugar-free-friendly.
instructions: In a small bowl, sprinkle the gelatin over 1/4 cup of cold water and let it soften for 5 minutes.
In a large saucepan, combine the chicken broth, spicy tomato sauce, and yellow food colouring, and bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and add the softened gelatin, stirring until it is fully dissolved.
Add the cod fish fillets to the saucepan and simmer for 8 minutes or until they are cooked through.
Remove the fish from the saucepan and set it aside on a plate.
Increase the heat to medium and add the lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and black pepper to the saucepan, stirring to combine.
Bring the sauce to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes or until it has thickened into a glassy-jelly sauce.
Stir in the chopped fresh dill and cook for an additional minute.
Serve the cod fish fillets with the spicy glassy-jelly sauce spooned over the top.
